name: videopsalm-electron
description: VideoPsalm 1.29 clean-room reimplementation (Electron target). Offline-first worship presenter.

scripts.copy:html: mkdir -p dist/src/renderer && cp src/renderer/*.html dist/src/renderer/ && cp src/renderer/*.css dist/src/renderer/ 2>/dev/null; true
scripts.start: npm run build && dbus-run-session -- npx electron dist/src/main.js --disable-gpu --disable-software-rasterizer
scripts.start:control-only: npm run build && dbus-run-session -- npx electron dist/src/main.js --control-only --disable-gpu --disable-software-rasterizer
scripts.dev: npm run build && dbus-run-session -- npx electron dist/src/main.js --dev --disable-gpu --disable-software-rasterizer
